segment.source: Create a token with a name that points to the MCP portal and an expiry date. Grant only the permissions the tools need, read access first.

segment.source: Set the shortest expiry that works for you. The token acts with your permissions in ; the portal does not extend them.
segment.target: Ustaw najkrótszy termin ważności, który Ci odpowiada. Token działa z Twoimi uprawnieniami w systemie ; portal ich nie rozszerza.

segment.source: One address covers all systems you have entitlements for. The client shows the model tools named system__tool, and the platform routes each call to the right system. Nothing is saved here: the choices below only change the address.

segment.source: The list has about tools. Tool descriptions take up model context and make tool selection worse, so narrow the address to the systems you need, or to read-only tools.

segment.source: The gateway returns tools per page; the client must fetch the next pages, otherwise it will only see the first one.

segment.source: The address will appear once the selection fits within the limit.
segment.target: Adres pojawi się, gdy wybór zmieści się w limicie.

segment.source: One session reaches all selected systems. Text from one of them, for example a Confluence page with a planted instruction, can push the model to write to another. Entitlements do not change, and irreversible operations still require a code from the Authenticator, but the reach of such an attack grows. For read-only work, choose "Read-only".
segment.target: Jedna sesja sięga do wszystkich wybranych systemów. Tekst z jednego z nich, na przykład strona w Confluence z podrzuconym poleceniem, może skłonić model do zapisu w innym. Uprawnienia się nie zmieniają, a operacje nieodwracalne dalej wymagają kodu z Authenticatora, ale zasięg takiego ataku rośnie. Do pracy tylko z czytaniem wybierz "Tylko odczyt".

segment.source: A filter does not grant entitlements. It only narrows what the client sees, so it is not a substitute for access restrictions.
